runs.text: The document states that sodium causes a much larger volume expansion in sulfur cathodes than lithium does. In the introduction, the greater volume expansion is named as a particular challenge of room-temperature sodium sulfur batteries compared with lithium sulfur batteries:

runs.quote: volume expansion (260% for Na versus 80% for Li)

runs.text: . The sodium figure is later tied to the expansion of the sulfur-to-sodium discharge product in this work:

runs.quote: theoretically leading to a 260% volume expansion
